name: Liars' Island
original_name: ライアーズ・アイランド
source:
A young man moved to a small island to escape from everything.
One day in the summer, he meet a boy.
The two, who had a wound in their hearts, found hope in the "lie".
No one knows, their summer vacation begins.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/4839]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
一个年轻人为了逃避一切搬到了一个小岛。
夏天的一天，他遇到了一个男孩。
内心受过伤的两人，在“谎言”中找到了希望。
没有人知道，他们的暑假开始了。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/4839]NovelGame[/url]]
